init_Wav2VecFeatureReader: initialize a Wav2VecFeatureReader with a checkpoint path, layer number, and optional CUDA flag
read_audio_Wav2VecFeatureReader: read an audio file and return a mono waveform numpy array with optional channel selection
get_feats_Wav2VecFeatureReader: extract Wav2Vec 2.0 features from an audio file at a specified model layer
run_inference_Wav2VecFeatureReader: run Wav2Vec 2.0 model inference on audio to extract features_only representations from a given layer
load_checkpoint_Wav2VecFeatureReader: load a Wav2Vec 2.0 checkpoint and build the fairseq task and model for feature extraction
